# TruffleHog path exclusion list
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. Each other line is a regex matched
# against the file path. Matches are excluded from secret scanning.

# Test files — may contain deliberately invalidated fake credentials used
# to exercise error-handling and negative-path logic. These are NOT real
# secrets: they are either randomly generated strings with no valid scope,
# or strings explicitly documented here as test fixtures.
#
# Test secret exception (invalidated / never-valid):
#   STELLAR_TEST_FAKE_API_KEY=sk_test_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
#   This key format is intentionally structured to trip pattern-based scanners
#   so CI can verify the --fail path. It has never been issued and is invalid.
.*test.*
.*spec.*
tests/.*
__tests__/.*

# Seed and fixture data scripts
scripts/seed\.js
stellar-payment-platform/scripts/seed\.js

# Documentation examples (webhook-signature-verification.md contains
# placeholder HMAC keys used in code samples)
docs/.*\.md

# Environment template files containing documented dummy placeholders
.*\.env\.example.*
\.env\.example
payment-dashboard/\.env
